name: comp-551
title: File Upload Table View
description: A files manager in table form: a count heading with Add files and Remove all, then a bordered table listing each attachment's icon and name, its type, size, and download and delete buttons.
use: Many attachments need managing after upload, with download and delete on every row.
avoid: The table has no sorting or row selection, so Remove all is the only batch action.
a11y: Every row action is a labelled button and the empty state offers a Select files button; the surrounding drop area is not focusable. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark panel headed Files (6) with two small outlined buttons at the right. Below, a bordered table with a grey header row (Name, Type, Size, Actions) and six white rows where names carry a small file glyph and the last column holds two faint icons.
behaves: Add files opens the picker and Remove all empties the table; each row's download icon opens its file while the bin drops that row. Rows tint under the pointer, and the list grows from three to six files across the frames.
customise: The ten-file cap, the 10MB ceiling and three seed files are written in the file; the icon mapping and row actions are source edits too.
weight: light: A short table of seed files and a hidden input; no animation loop.
